description: DEP-05 "When a quorum_expired dispute ends" and DEP-06 "Losers yield": where a DisputeYield is valid on a fork. A fork in the disputed state (entered, never armed) or the armed state takes a DisputeYield, which tombstones it; a fork never disputed, one already tombstoned, and one whose DisputeAcquire stands (back in the normal state) refuse it. Each case builds a fork from a fresh ledger by applying `ops` in order (every one must be accepted), then applies one DisputeYield. `state_before` is the dispute state after `ops`, `armed` whether `ops` hold a DisputeArmed, `yield` the verdict, and `state_after` the state when it is accepted. Ops: `enter` (DisputeEnter, reason in `reason`), `arm` (DisputeArmed with replacement collateral), `arm_bare` (DisputeArmed declaring none), `arm_round_2` (DisputeArmed, rearm_round 2, fresh commitment), `yield`, `acquire` (DisputeAcquire). Shared by deposits-rust (deposits-core/tests/vectors/dispute_yield_states.json) and cl-deposits (inspect/vectors/dispute_yield_states.json). Signet 2026-11-20: Rust refused an un-armed yield and cl accepted a yield in every state; ref7's un-armed expiry fork of 5effb9e8 could not stand down and absorbed a punitive dispute.
